user.title: EEBUS Bridge
user.description: Enter the address of the EEBUS Bridge add-on API. With the bundled add-on (host network) use your Home Assistant host IP.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the EEBUS Bridge API.
error.no_ski: The add-on did not report a SKI yet. Make sure it has finished starting.

abort.already_configured: This EEBUS Bridge is already configured.

set_consumption_limit.name: Set consumption limit
set_consumption_limit.description: Send an LPC consumption limit to the inverter (Home Assistant acting as Energy Guard).

duration_s.name: Duration
duration_s.description: Duration in seconds (0 = no time limit).

set_production_limit.name: Set production limit
set_production_limit.description: Send an LPP production limit to the inverter (Home Assistant acting as Energy Guard).

duration_s.name: Duration
duration_s.description: Duration in seconds (0 = no time limit).

trust_device.name: Trust device
trust_device.description: Trust a remote EEBUS device by its SKI so it can pair with the bridge. The trust is persisted by the add-on.

ski.name: SKI
ski.description: The 40-character hexadecimal SKI of the remote device.

forget_device.name: Forget device
forget_device.description: Remove the trust for a remote EEBUS device. SKIs listed in the add-on configuration are trusted again after an add-on restart.

ski.name: SKI
ski.description: The 40-character hexadecimal SKI of the remote device.

set_device_limit.name: Set device limit
set_device_limit.description: Set and/or apply a consumption (LPC) or production (LPP) limit on one EEBUS device, e.g. dim a heat pump or wallbox. Requires enable_eg_control in the add-on.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The EEBUS device (inverter, wallbox, heat pump, ...).

ski.name: SKI
ski.description: Alternatively the 40-character SKI of the device.

value_w.name: Limit
value_w.description: Limit in watts. Omit to keep the current value.

active.name: Active
active.description: Apply (true) or remove (false) the limit. Omit to only stage the value.

simulate_grid_limit.name: Simulate grid operator limit (§14a)
simulate_grid_limit.description: TEST ONLY: simulate an incoming §14a consumption limit from the grid operator, as if a control box had sent it. Runs through the normal distribution and ends after the duration. Requires enable_lpc_simulation in the add-on and is refused while a real control box is connected or a real limit is active.

battery_soc.name: Leading inverter battery state of charge

init.title: PV-surplus charging
init.description: Settings for the wallbox charge modes. The grid power sensor must be positive when importing (enable the inversion otherwise). Leave it empty to use a grid meter connected via EEBUS (MGCP).

data.grid_power_inverted: Sensor is positive when feeding in
data.max_charge_power_w: Maximum charging power (if the wallbox does not report one)

data_description.grid_power_entity: Power sensor of your grid connection, positive when importing (e.g. from your inverter or smart meter integration). Leave empty to use a grid meter connected via EEBUS.
data_description.grid_power_inverted: Enable if the sensor is positive while feeding in.
data_description.surplus_reserve_w: Power kept back for the house when charging from PV surplus.
data_description.min_charge_power_w: Below this the car cannot charge (6 A three-phase = 4140 W, single-phase = 1380 W).
data_description.max_charge_power_w: Used when the wallbox does not report its maximum (11 kW = 16 A three-phase).
data_description.start_delay_s: PV mode: surplus must reach the minimum power this long before charging starts.
data_description.stop_delay_s: PV mode: charging continues at minimum power this long after the surplus drops.
data_description.control_interval_s: How often charge modes are re-evaluated.

eg_control_disabled.title: EEBUS devices cannot be controlled
eg_control_disabled.description: The EEBUS Bridge found {devices}, which can only be controlled when the bridge acts as Energy Guard. Enable `enable_eg_control` in the EEBUS Bridge add-on configuration and restart the add-on. Afterwards charge mode, limits and failsafe settings appear on the device.
